component.name: Gity
component.summary: Git client with undo, previews and every command shown

description.p: Gity is a desktop Git client for Linux, macOS and Windows: a fast commit graph, staging by file, hunk or line, merge, rebase and stash, and submodules opened as repositories of their own. It runs the git already on your system, so your credential helper, SSH agent, LFS and hooks behave exactly as they do in a terminal.

ul.li: Undo and redo for commits, merges, rebases, resets, checkouts, deleted branches and discards
A preview before every pull, merge, rebase and push, and force push only with a lease
Every git command shown, as you could type it yourself
Interactive rebase with reword, squash, fixup, drop and stop-to-edit
History filters by text, author and date, and branch comparison
Credentials kept only in git's own credential helper, never by Gity

description.p: Gity is early and largely untested. Try it on a copy of a repository before trusting it with one that matters.

screenshot.caption: History, with the commit graph and the selected commit's diff
Interactive rebase, with each action coloured by how much it changes
Local changes: staging by file, hunk or line

description.p: The first public release. Early and largely untested — please report what breaks.
